paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: : Left: Accuracy of all methods on each group of bias type in BBQ. Right: results on BBQ's testing set. All methods are applied on LLaMA-2-Chat-7B. For accuracy (A%_{}), higher values are better; for unknown-answer response rate (U%_{}), bias score (BS%_{}) and stereotypical response rate (SR%_{}), lower is better. We use bold font for the best result in each column, and mark the methods that improve ICL. : significant improvements on ICL in A% by pair-wise t-test with p < 0.05.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of different models on a TruthfulQA task as a function of the number of demonstrations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2000, with tick labels at intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled "MCI" and also uses a linear scale, ranging from 37 to 39, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines in the plot. The first line, "Linear SAE," is depicted in dark blue with circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at an MCI of 37 at 0 demonstrations, rises to approximately 38 by 250 demonstrations, and further increases to around 39 at 2000 demonstrations. The second line, "LLaMA-2-chat-7B", is shown in pink with a dashed line style and no markers, remaining constant at an MCI value of slightly below 37 across all demonstration values. The third line, "ICD", is represented in light blue with a dashed line style and no markers, remaining constant at an MCI value of approximately 37.9 throughout the x-axis range. A legend is give top left describing the line and color.
